# Defend Plane Change Record

This branch makes Killinchu the single public Aegis/Sentra cyber-resilience surface.

- Aegis remains the portfolio name.
- Sentra becomes a source-bound capability plane.
- `/defend` is a dedicated same-origin tab with real workflow state and receipts.
- Public actions remain rehearsal-only; effectors and arbitrary commands are disabled.
- A persistent live contract waits for the exact Hugging Face deployment before retirement can proceed.
